meta.title: Support for EU membership
meta.question: Do Poles support their country's membership of the European Union?
meta.measure: Supporters of EU membership, % of those with a view
meta.anchor: Read on the scale of CBOS's question "Are you a supporter or an opponent of Poland's integration with (since 2004: membership of) the European Union?", in its face-to-face surveys up to 2020.

items.wording: Is your impression of the European Community/Union generally positive, neutral or negative?
items.notes: Central and Eastern Eurobarometer; the only item in 1990 and 1993-94. Neutral answers are left out.

items.wording: Would you be for or against Poland becoming a member of the European Community?
items.notes: Central and Eastern Eurobarometer 1991-92.

items.wording: Are you a supporter or an opponent of Poland's integration with (from 2004: membership of) the European Union?
items.notes: The anchor: the trend is read on this question's scale. Face-to-face surveys up to April 2020. CBOS 'Trendy' series.

items.wording: Should Poland unite with the European Union or keep its independence?
items.notes: PGSS 1995 (ISSP National Identity).

items.wording: If there were a referendum tomorrow on Poland's membership of the EU, would you vote for or against?
items.notes: Central and Eastern Eurobarometer 1995-97.

items.wording: Will Poland's joining the EU be better (helpful) or worse (destructive) for the country's development?
items.notes: POLPAN 1998 and 2003, 2 waves; the English labels differ (better/worse, helpful/destructive) for what is the same prospective question. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: If a referendum were held, would you vote for Poland joining the European Union?
items.notes: POLPAN 1998, 1 wave (panel with refreshment sample, unweighted). Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: Would membership bring Poland much more disadvantages than advantages (1) ... much more advantages than disadvantages (5)?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2000-03, 6 surveys. Middle 'as many advantages as disadvantages' at 5. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: Taking everything into consideration, would Poland benefit or not from being a member of the EU?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2000-04, 8 surveys (2000.1 to 2004.1). 'Respondent benefits' (personal) is a separate, unused variable. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: Generally speaking, do you think that Poland's membership of the EU would be a good thing, a bad thing, or neither?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2000-04. 'Neither' is left out.

items.wording: If there were a referendum on Poland's membership of the EU, would you vote for or against?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2000-03 (in October 2003, how one would vote now).

items.wording: If a referendum on joining the EU were held today, would you vote for or against?
items.notes: Polish National Election Study 2001 and 2005.

items.wording: Are you a supporter or an opponent of Poland's integration with (from 2004: membership of) the European Union?
items.notes: CBOS's support question in the few months whose microdata differ from CBOS's published series by more than 4 points (October 2002, April and May 2003, September 2004); a question of its own.

items.wording: Generally speaking, do you think that Poland's membership of the EU is a good thing, a bad thing, or neither?
items.notes: Standard and Parliament Eurobarometers, 2004-26, in the coding where 'neither' is code 2 (files to about 2016).

items.wording: The membership of Poland in the European Union is a good thing (yes, rather / no, rather not)
items.notes: Flash Eurobarometer 162 (ZA4186), June 2004, telephone, just after the EP election; asked of everyone. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: Generally speaking, do you think that Poland's membership of the EU is a good thing, a bad thing, or neither? (neither at 5)
items.notes: European Election Study voter studies 2004, 2009, 2014 and 2019 (EESX), 4 surveys; same codes (1 good, 2 bad, 3 neither) in all four. 2019 was online. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: Taking everything into account, would you say that Poland has on balance benefited or not from being a member of the EU? (benefited = pro)
items.notes: Standard and Parliament Eurobarometer, 2004-26, 32 surveys (EB 62.0 to 105.2). The member-state version only: the candidate-country versions ('Would benefit') fail the label check. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: In a referendum on whether Poland should remain in the EU, would you vote to remain or to leave?
items.notes: PGSS 2005 (ISSP National Identity 2003 module).

items.wording: Has Poland's entry into the EU had a positive or negative impact on the country, or no impact at all? (no impact at 5)
items.notes: POLPAN 2008, 1 wave. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: Generally speaking, do you think our country's membership in the European Union is a good thing, a bad thing, or neither good nor bad? (neither and volunteered both at 5)
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes fall 2009, spring 2012 and spring 2019 (3 surveys with Polish answers; the 2011 file has the question but no Polish answers). Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: Poland could better face the future outside the EU (agree or disagree)
items.notes: Standard Eurobarometer.

items.wording: Taking everything into account, has Poland lost or gained from EU membership? (0 lost a lot, 5 neither, 10 gained a lot)
items.notes: POLPAN 2013 and 2018, 2 waves. In 2013 asked in two questionnaire versions under two variables (UE02, about 2,300 answers; UZP6, about 500): the pipeline reads one variable per survey, so the regex names UE02 and the UZP6 respondents are lost. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: In a referendum tomorrow, would you vote for Poland to remain a member of the EU or to leave?
items.notes: European Social Survey rounds 8-11.

items.wording: Should Poland remain in or leave the EU?
If there were a referendum on Poland's EU membership, would you vote to remain or to leave?
items.notes: European Parliament Eurobarometer.

items.wording: How would you vote in a referendum on Poland's EU membership?
items.notes: Several pollsters (IBRiS, Kantar, OGB, Opinia24, SW Research, United Surveys).

items.wording: Would Poland develop better inside or outside the EU?
Membership support on a four-point scale
Imagine there were a referendum tomorrow about EU membership: would you vote for Poland to remain a member or to leave? (blank, spoilt, would not vote, undecided: no position)
items.notes: European Election Study 2019 (online), 1 survey. Read by 18_more_microdata.R through the generic readers (data-raw/items_more.csv); the middle answer, where there is one, takes no side.

items.wording: Are you a supporter or an opponent of Poland's integration with (from 2004: membership of) the European Union?
items.notes: CBOS's mixed-mode surveys (CAPI, CATI or CAWI, the respondent's choice) from APiW 359 (May-June 2020), so a question of its own.

items.wording: Should Poland leave the EU?
Should Poland remain in or leave the EU? (four-point scale)
Do you approve of Poland's EU membership?
Should Poland leave the EU? (four-point scale)
Generally speaking, do you think that Poland's membership of the EU is a good thing, a bad thing, or neither?
items.notes: European Election Study 2024 voter study.

items.wording: Approval of EU membership (wording as reported on Wikipedia)
Should Poland begin the procedure of leaving the EU?
